extraction_focus: Pay close attention to named team members and their assigned tasks, milestone dates, blockers with owners, budget figures, stakeholder approvals needed, and decisions made with rationale.
compaction_preserve: Team member names and responsibilities, milestone dates and current status, active blockers and owners, budget and resource constraints, decisions made with date and rationale.
compaction_compress: General project methodology discussion, repeated scope background, resolved blockers with no lingering impact.
